title: Pfalzgraf Carl August Christian von Birkenfeld-Zweibrücken
collection: Bayerische Staatsgemäldesammlungen – Neue Pinakothek München (not on display; 1844 from the Herzog-Max-Burg, Munich)
reproduction_credit: Carl Kaspar Pitz, Pfalzgraf Carl August Christian von Birkenfeld-Zweibrücken, vor 1795, Bayerische Staatsgemäldesammlungen – Neue Pinakothek München (CC BY-SA 4.0)
status_note: Museum released CC BY-SA 4.0 (licence link on the collection page). Resized to 1600 px and metadata stripped; this derivative stays CC BY-SA 4.0 with the credit above.
use: Best colour reference: face 3/4 right, eye colour, complexion, wig (side rolls, black bag ribbon), blue uniform with black velvet collar and lapels, silver epaulette, red Hubertus sash over the blue St George sash

title: Karl II. August Christian, Herzog von Pfalz-Zweibrücken (1746 Düsseldorf – 1795 Mannheim)
artist: Attributed to Carl Kaspar Pitz (museum: attribution based on the Munich pastel; 'a copy after Pitz by another hand is also possible')
collection: Historisches Museum der Pfalz, Speyer (Gemäldesammlung Ludwig I. von Bayern; 1969 gift of the Bayerische Staatsgemäldesammlungen to Rhineland-Palatinate)
reproduction_credit: Historisches Museum der Pfalz, Speyer – photo: Ehrenamtsgruppe HMP Speyer (CC BY 4.0)
status_note: Museum: image rights 'CC BY' (linked to CC BY 4.0) on museum-digital; the object's text metadata are CC BY-NC-SA and are only summarised here. Stored at the museum's 960 px size, metadata stripped. The pale flecks on the collar are paint losses, not costume.
use: Second colour reference of the same type: fringed silver epaulette, sash edge stripes (red sash with dark green edges, light blue sash with white edge), face 3/4 right

title: Karl II. August, Herzog von Pfalz-Zweibrücken (plate 3, 'zu S. 320')
artist: Johann Christian Mannlich (painting); halftone plate in E. Stollreither (ed.), Ein deutscher Maler und Hofmann. Lebenserinnerungen des Joh. Christian v. Mannlich, Berlin: Mittler 1910
date: painting 1790 (date per Commons record, citing Lohmeyer/Dahl 1957); plate published 1910
medium: oil on canvas, 63 × 47 cm (per Commons); reproduced as a halftone plate
collection: Formerly Hauptmann v. Mannlich-Lehmann, Berlin (caption of the plate); war loss (per Commons)
reproduction_licence: Public domain: plate photo published 1910, so photo protection under §72 UrhG (50 years after publication) ended in 1960; the scan is a plain page scan
reproduction_credit: Scan: Internet Archive, digitised from a copy of the Getty Research Institute
status_note: 1910 printed reproduction of a painting that is now lost. Internet Archive page scan, no rights claimed in the item metadata. Cropped to the plate with its caption, resized, metadata stripped.
use: The only portrait of the duke by Mannlich himself, late Karlsberg years (age c. 43–44): face front-3/4, double chin, wig rolls, velvet court coat, lace jabot, breast star and cross

title: Herzog Karl II. August von Zweibrücken
medium: oil on canvas, 63 × 47 cm (per Commons); black-and-white book reproduction
collection: Formerly family collection v. Mannlich-Lehmann, Berlin; war loss (per Commons)
reproduction_licence: Commons: Licensed-PD-Art (PD-old) with the uploader's scan released under CC BY-SA 4.0
reproduction_credit: Scan: Wikimedia Commons user ONAR (CC BY-SA 4.0), from K. Lohmeyer / J. Dahl (ed.), Das barocke Zweibrücken und seine Meister, 2nd ed., Waldfischbach 1957, p. 307
status_note: Commons: PD-Art, uploader's own scan released CC BY-SA 4.0. The printed photo must predate the painting's war loss and was published in 1957 at the latest, so its §72 protection has expired. Same painting as the 1910 plate; sharper face and insignia detail.
use: Face detail (eyes, nose, mouth, jowls) and insignia detail (breast star, cross badge, lapel jewel)

title: Carl II. August
medium: oil on canvas (photographed in its frame on the museum wall)
collection: Kurpfälzisches Museum der Stadt Heidelberg (on display when photographed, 2020)
reproduction_credit: Photo: Z thomas, Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0)
status_note: Commons: photographer's own photo, self-licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 (plus PD-Art for the painting). Resized, metadata incl. GPS stripped; derivative stays CC BY-SA 4.0.
use: Young duke (c. 29) in state armour: face front, fuller curled wig, steel cuirass, ermine-lined blue velvet mantle, red sash, lace jabot and cuffs, plumed helmet

title: Carolus II. Com. Palat. Rheni de Gemino Ponte Bav. Dux (plate 150 in 'Series imaginum augustae domus Boicae')
artist: Joseph Anton Zimmermann (1705–1797), engraver; 'juxta originale Bipontini' (after an original in Zweibrücken)
date: after April 1780: the inscription calls him Grand Prior of the Order of St George, an office he held from 24 April 1780 (the series itself was begun in 1773)
medium: copper engraving, plate in a bound volume
status_note: Library marks the digital copy Public Domain Mark 1.0 (licence field of the IIIF manifest). Cropped server-side via IIIF to the plate, re-encoded at 1400 px.
use: Three-quarter-length pose in the Pitz uniform type: dark plastron, fringed epaulette with rosettes on the right shoulder, sash from left shoulder to right hip with the St Hubert cross at the hip, part of a breast star, ermine mantle, crown on cushion, hands on a long staff; Latin titles

title: Bildnis des Herzogs Karl III. August Christian von Pfalz-Zweibrücken
artist: Unknown South German painter, after a painting by 'Bauer' c. 1780 (archive card; possibly a misreading of Lauer, not verified)
date: painting c. 1780 (record: 1751/1800); photograph taken between 1885 and 1914
medium: oil on canvas, oval (record: 79.5 × 32.2 cm, width looks implausible)
collection: Bayerisches Nationalmuseum, München (no. 665 in the record), as photographed c. 1885–1914
inventory_number: 665 (per record); Foto Marburg image no. mi02297c13, record DE-Mb112/lido/obj/00060303
reproduction_credit: Bildarchiv Foto Marburg (photo: Carl Teufel / Dr. Benno Filser Verlag)
status_note: Foto Marburg released this historic archive photo as CC0 1.0 (via Deutsche Digitale Bibliothek). Whole archive card kept, with its typed caption.
use: Uniform variant with epaulettes and a breast star on the left chest; heavier, older-looking face

title: Karl II. August als Generalissimus bei der Rückkehr seines Régiments Royal-Deux-Ponts aus dem amerikanischen Unabhängigkeitskrieg
reproduction_licence: Commons: PD-art-old-100-expired only; no licence for the photo itself
reproduction_credit: Commons user Oktobersonne ('own work'), described as 'Repro-Ausschnitt'
status_note: Not downloaded: unclear. The uploader's only other 'Repro' upload is a photo of a printed newspaper page, so this may be a photo of a printed reproduction whose own photographer (likely the palace administration) holds §72 rights. Open the link to look.
use: Most important full-length image of the Karlsberg years: steel cuirass over buff leather sleeves, buff breeches, black jackboots with spurs, red and blue sashes crossed, cross at the neck, ermine-lined crimson mantle, white waist sash with gold fringe, baton, black tricorne with fur trim in hand, crown on cushion, a Black servant in a turban, army camp behind

title: Karl II. August Christian Herzog von Pfalz-Zweibrücken (second version of the Pitz type)

status_note: Not downloaded: non-commercial licence, not clearly compatible with a public MIT repository. The museum text notes 'Auf dem breiten Kopf weiße Perücke mit seitlichen Lockenrollen'.
use: Confirms the Pitz type (third version incl. the Munich pastel)

title: Karl II. August Christian Pfalzgraf von Birkenfeld-Zweibrücken
reproduction_licence: Unclear: Commons PD-Art only; image taken from N. Jeffares' pastellists.com article on Lauer, original photographer not named
